card.line: Canaan is the land west of the Jordan that God promised to Abraham's family as an eternal possession, and it is where Israel's story takes place.

moments.title: Abram Arrives in Canaan
moments.text: Abram takes Sarai, Lot, and all their people and goods and sets out for Canaan. There the LORD appears and says He will give this land to Abram's offspring, and Abram builds an altar.

moments.title: God Promises the Land
moments.text: God makes His covenant with Abraham. He promises to give Abraham and his descendants all the land of Canaan as an eternal possession, and to be their God.

moments.title: Sarah Dies in Canaan
moments.text: Sarah dies in Hebron in the land of Canaan, and Abraham mourns and weeps for her. He then asks the Hittites for a burial site.

moments.title: Twelve Spies Sent Out
moments.text: The LORD tells Moses to send one leader from each tribe to spy out Canaan. Moses tells them to see what the land and its people are like and to bring back some of its fruit.

moments.title: The Spies' Report
moments.text: After forty days the spies return with a huge cluster of grapes. They say the land flows with milk and honey, but its people are strong. Caleb says Israel can certainly conquer it.

moments.title: Manna Stops in Canaan
moments.text: At Gilgal, the Israelites keep the Passover and eat from the produce of the land. The next day the manna stops, and they begin to eat the crops of Canaan.
